_readme: Every address the code uses, in one place (owner, 2026-11-14): the company's sites, this computer's dev servers, the outside services, the default mail senders. The server and the scripts read it (src/addresses); npm run sync:app writes it into the app and the 管理后台 (app/lib/generated/addresses.dart); the website's npm run sync copies it (src/generated/addresses.json), and so does the website CMS's (C:\CameywareCorpApps\website\OfficialWebsiteCMS, src/generated/addresses.json: its two addresses and ports). Change a value here, then run both syncs. An environment variable or a --dart-define still wins where one is named. Not here: code that tells an address apart (loopback checks), throwaway test data, and packages/store/docker-compose.yml's Postgres port (compose can't read this file: keep it equal to local.postgresPort).
